_provenance.experiment: Dense mass-adaptation protocol fix (Option B). Re-run of the Impulse arm of the two discrete-latent PPLBench models (crowd_sourced_annotation, noisy_or_topic) under the standard matched-init protocol with a DENSE initial inverse mass matrix, so Impulse adapts a dense Welford mass consistent with the reference arms (NumPyro dense_mass=True, Stan dense_e, Turing DenseEuclideanMetric). Previously these two models passed a rank-1 (diagonal) initial inverse mass, selecting the O(N) diagonal kernel while the baselines adapted a dense O(N^2/N^3) kernel, so the n_eff/s comparison on these two models was not apples-to-apples.
code_change: standard/crowd_sourced_annotation.jl: removed setup() field `inverse_mass_matrix = ones(Float64, position_size)` (commented out) so it falls through to the harness dense-eye default Matrix{Float64}(I, position_size, position_size).
standard/noisy_or_topic.jl: removed setup() field `inverse_mass_matrix = ones(Float64, 2 * P)` (commented out) likewise.
_provenance.protocol: iterations 4000, warmup 1000, 4 trials (trials-as-chains), model seed 12345, step_size 0.1, max_tree_depth 10, adapt_step_size true, adapt_mass_matrix true (DENSE), cpu, 32 threads. Impulse init already deterministic uniform/zeros (matched). Adaptation is ON.
_provenance.reference_arms_unchanged: NumPyro/Stan/Turing arms of both models are preserved from sec53_matched_init_suite_2026-07-14.json (noisy_or) and annotation_matched_init_results_2026-07-14.json (annotation); they already adapted dense mass and are correct under Option B.
_provenance.adapt_off_validate_gate: run_all_validate.sh (adaptation OFF) re-run after the code change: 5/5 NUTS models PASS, no regression (crowd_sourced_annotation worst_max_diff 1.069145e-13 unchanged, noisy_or_topic 0.0 unchanged). The validate gate does not exercise mass adaptation and is not the deliverable; recorded only to confirm no regression.
_provenance.ess_metric: PPLBench overall_neff = arviz pooled ESS over the 4 trials-as-chains (post-warmup); median over all latent scalar params; overall_neff_per_time = pooled n_eff / steady-state per-trial inference wall (excluding trial 0). Extracted with the same matched_suite/extract_arm.py used to build the 07-14 suite.
